sources.note: Nothing. The report describes Mur village (Rai Coast, Madang): Mur Pano [tkv], Molet, Dawang. Malasanga [mqz] = 'Morobe Pano' (dialects Malasanga, Singorokai) appears only as comparison wordlists elicited by Scot Stober in July 2009 (Appendix E, image pages, printed pp. 51-64), transcribed without stress marks; lexicostatistics 59%/63% with Mur Pano (pp. 14-15). App. B.1 'Characteristics of Mur Pano' (pp. 40-41) gives a phone chart and morphology for tkv only, no prosody. Cites Stober 2009 'Pano survey' (unpublished MS).
